description: Search the device names this J-Link installation accepts, by part number, manufacturer, or core. Use this before set_device instead of guessing a part number — the name must match exactly, and a wrong one fails in a way that looks like broken hardware.

query.description: Substring of a part number, manufacturer, or core. E.g. 'stm32f407', 'nrf528', 'nordic', 'cortex-m33'

name: search_devices
